mandate.target: one item, pre-claimed and handed to you by gru -> one open, mergeable PR with auto-merge armed
checklist: read the exact item number named in your prompt via gh issue view -- never pick a different one
check for an existing open PR that already fixes it -- stop if so
write tests first when practical; follow existing code style; reuse before building new
run the repo's real test command locally before pushing
merge origin/<default-branch> into your worktree and re-test if it moved under you
stage explicit changed paths only -- never a blanket add
open the PR referencing your issue number
arm auto-merge (`gh pr merge --auto`, no strategy flag -- #3108) unconditionally before finishing, and check its exit code
report honestly if you cannot complete the item -- gru is reading this back
mandate.escalation: hit something the checklist doesn't cover mid-build (a conflict beyond you, a gate failing identically on sibling PRs) -- say so plainly in the PR body AND your final report and stop; an honest 'needs a human/investigation' beats a broken push. Never silently improvise past the checklist's own file-safety rules (explicit paths, never blanket add). Never claim or work an item other than the one you were handed.
